description:
Find out what term life insurance would cost you. Answer five quick questions, and Ethos will show you a personalized monthly price estimate right in ChatGPT. Explore coverage up to $3,000,000, adjust your term from 10 to 30 years, and when you're ready, one tap takes you to Ethos to finalize your rate.
• No medical exam required with just a few health questions
• Your best price from multiple carriers
• Get covered in as little as 10 minutes
• Every policy includes a free will & trust worth $898 (available in most states)

Note: All quoted prices are estimates and subject to underwriting.

defaultPrompt: how much is life insurance for a healthy 32yo male non-smoker in Ca?
